ee_number.description: Toast's employee number. Blank means unmapped.

regular_hours.description: Payable less overtime. Includes the supervisor adjustment.

hourly_rate.description: The employee's rate, or `null` when none is on file. Set by an admin on the user record. Always `null` when `pay_rates_included` is false.

ot_multiplier.description: The highest multiplier recorded on these register days, or 1.5 when none is recorded.

payout.description: `regular x rate + overtime x rate x ot_multiplier`, or **null** when no rate is on file. Always `null` when `pay_rates_included` is false.

currency.description: The rate's currency, falling back to the tenant's (USD when the tenant has none). The tenant's currency when `pay_rates_included` is false.

week.description: The week number within the pay period, starting at 1.

missing_ee_number.description: Employees with hours but no payroll number. Always present. It can hold names only with `allow_missing_ee_number=true`, because without it the export refuses.

unpriced_employees.description: Employees with hours but no hourly rate. Their rows still carry the hours, with `payout: null`. Always 0 when `pay_rates_included` is false, because no rate was read.

payout_by_currency.description: Totals keyed by currency and never summed across currencies. Rows with no rate add nothing here. Empty when `pay_rates_included` is false.

pay_rates_included.description: Whether `hourly_rate`, `payout` and `payout_by_currency` hold figures. True for a tenant admin. False for every other caller, and for a service with no signed-in user. Always present.

site_scoped.description: True when the export covers only the caller's sites

action.description: Each endpoint accepts a subset; see its description.

payload.description: The fields to write. Omitted for reads.

page_num.description: `total_count` is counted on page 1 only. Later pages answer `total_count: 0`.

page_size.description: Capped at 200 on work_shift and shift_change_request, 500 on the others.

match_filter_dict.description: Mongo-style filter, applied on top of tenant and access scoping.

ids_list.description: For `get_entity_ids`, the exact ids to read (at most 500). For `delete` (and the attendance actions), the ids to act on one by one.

data.description: Present on refusals that name something, e.g. `{"shift_count": 12}`.

start_time_min.description: Minutes from midnight, 0–1439. The stored form of start_time.

site_code.description: The tenant site this definition belongs to (`tenant.site_list[].code`).

timezone.description: IANA name; an unknown name is `WORK_SHIFT_TIMEZONE_INVALID`

break_list.description:
Breaks on this shift definition. Send `kind` (`rest`, `meal`, `other`),
`start` (minutes from midnight or `HH:MM`) and `minutes`; `start_min` /
`duration_min` are accepted too. With a `kind`, `is_paid` is decided by
the server (rest paid, meal and other unpaid) and a client value is
ignored. When the body sends `break_list` with at least one `kind`, and
sends neither total, `unpaid_break_minutes` and `paid_break_minutes` are
set from the whole list. `WORK_SHIFT_BREAK_KIND_INVALID`
for another kind.

min_minutes_full_day.description: Worked minutes below this make the day `partial`

people_needed.description: How many people this shift definition needs each day it runs. Optional; null is no headcount. A whole number 1 to 500 (a numeric string is accepted); anything else is refused with `WORK_SHIFT_PEOPLE_NEEDED_INVALID` and `data` `{min: 1, max: 500}`. Always present on list and get, null when unset. The roster and Assign crew report `short_by`, and nothing is refused for being short.

require_biometric.description: The employer's policy, copied to roster rows. Send a JSON boolean: a string is stored as sent, and "false" is truthy.

auto_clock_out.description: See /attendance_day/process. Send a JSON boolean: a string is stored as sent, and "false" is truthy.

geofence_radius_m.description: 0, or at least 161 (`WORK_SHIFT_GEOFENCE_RADIUS_TOO_SMALL`). With 0, a site that allows clock-in only nearby uses 805.

start_time.description: This shift's own start, `"HH:MM"` or minutes after midnight, site wall time. Send with `end_time`. Not stored under this name.

end_time.description: This shift's own end. At or before the start means the next day.

use_definition_times.description: true: go back to the shift definition's times

times_overridden.description: True when this shift's times were changed and differ from its definition

start_time_min_override.description: The changed start in minutes after midnight. 0 when `times_overridden` is false.

end_time_min_override.description: The changed end in minutes after midnight. 0 when `times_overridden` is false.

job_title.description: Copied from the shift unless sent

site_code.description: The tenant site (`tenant.site_list[].code`). Copied from the shift definition unless sent. An unregistered or inactive code is `SITE_CODE_INVALID`.

crew_id.description: Set by Assign crew; a client cannot write it

crew_name.description: Snapshot of the crew name when assigned

email.description: Only to a supervisor at the crew's site. A member reading their own crew gets userid and name only.

phone.description: As stored on the user. Only to a supervisor at the crew's site; empty when the user has none.

notes.description: On GET one, create and PATCH; not on the list

member_userid_list.description: `null` is read as an empty list.

status.description: Generate only. `completed` is refused per row.

skip_existing.description: Send a JSON boolean. Any non-empty string, "false" included, is read as true.

reason_code.description: ALREADY_ON_A_SHIFT, NOT_AT_SITE, OUTSIDE_DAYS, ON_LEAVE or a refusal code; absent on create

shift_assignment_id.description: Generate only, on a created row

dates_applicable.description: Generate: distinct dates the pattern produced

slots_generated.description: Generate: date and shift pairs the pattern produced

replayed.description: Generate; true when a client_request_id was answered from the first run

staffing.description: Preview with people or a crew, and Generate: one entry per date and shift definition

people_after.description: People on it that day after this request

short_by.description: 0 when enough, or when people_needed is null

break_type.description: On `break_start` only, and `''` on every other direction. Stored on the punch and returned on every read.

break_is_paid.description: Set by the server from `break_type`: `rest` is paid, `meal`, `other` and a blank type are not. Stored on the punch. The register splits paid break time from unpaid break time on this field.

verification.description: `device_biometric` is the device's own check. No template reaches this server.

site_code.description: The roster row's site, else the shift definition's, else the one site all the day's punches were recorded at.

unpaid_break_minutes.description: Equal to break_minutes. On list and get reads.

paid_break_minutes.description: Paid break time kept in the hours. The punched paid minutes, capped at the shift's `paid_break_minutes`, when the day has break punches. The shift's `paid_break_minutes` when it has none.

ot_approved_by_userid.description: Who approved the overtime. Set by `approve_overtime`, and by `approve` with `approve_overtime: true`. Empty when the overtime is not approved.

ot_approved_ts.description: When the overtime was approved, in epoch seconds. 0 when the overtime is not approved. A day whose overtime was approved before this field existed also reads 0.

manual_adjust_minutes.description: Kept when the day is processed again

auto_clocked_out.description: The processor closed an open span at the scheduled end

exception_list.description: `late_arrival` · `early_departure` · `missing_punch` · `unscheduled` · `unscheduled_at_site` · `overtime` · `long_shift` (span over 16 hours) · `no_show` · `geofence_violation` · `auto_clock_out` · `break_over_allowance` (punched paid break ran past the shift's `paid_break_minutes`)

is_locked.description: A locked day refuses processing, adjust, approve, unapprove, approve_overtime, unapprove_overtime and edits to its punches. Unlocking needs U and D.

processor_version.description: Which policy build produced the row. `ta-1.1.0` caps paid break time at the shift's allowance.

shift_change_request_id.description: On a create response only. Reads carry `id`.

status.description: `expired`: nobody decided it before its shift ended (a swap: the first of its two shifts). `shift_removed`: the roster row it was about was deleted, so it can never be approved. Both are set by the server, and neither changes anything on the roster. The requester reads an `expired` request for 7 days after `expired_ts`. A `shift_removed` request stays in the requester's list with no time limit.

shift_assignment_id.description: The row to give up (drop / swap)

requested_shift_date_str.description: YYYY-MM-DD. A value that is not a date is refused as `REQUESTED_SHIFT_NOT_IN_FUTURE`.

expired_ts.description: When the server closed it as expired. A request whose shift has ended but that is not closed yet reads its shift end here (now, when it has no stored end). The requester reads it for 7 days after this.

expires_at_ts.description: When the shift the request is about ends, in epoch seconds. Set when the request is made, and set again when the roster row's times or date move or the wanted definition's times change. Absent on requests made before it existed, until the hourly job reads their shift.

timezone.description: The zone the shift dates are read in, from the roster row or the wanted shift. Empty on requests made before it existed.

closed_reason.description: Why the server closed it, when a person did not. `shift_deleted`: its roster row was deleted, and it closed as `shift_removed`. Empty otherwise.

direction.description: Omit to toggle from the last punch

punch_ts.description: Epoch seconds or ISO 8601. Defaults to now. Send an ISO time with its offset: one with no zone is read in the server's zone.

source.description: Defaults to `mobile` on /clock, `terminal` on /ingest, `manual` on /manage and POST /user/punch_event.

verification.description: /clock accepts none, selfie, device_biometric, pin and access_code.

verification_confidence.description: A value that is not a number is stored as 0.

latitude.description: A value that is not a number, or out of range, is stored as 0 (unknown) with `longitude`.

timezone.description: Used for the day of a punch with no roster row

clocked_in.description: True when the last punch is in, break_start or break_end

next_direction.description: The toggle of the last punch: `out` after `in`, `in` after `out`, `break_end` after `break_start`, `out` after `break_end`. `in` when there is no punch.

policy.description: The requirements on the current roster row

clock_in_near_site.description: True when the row's site allows clock-in only nearby. The app then sends its location with the clock-in.

backfill_required.description: Approve only. True when a shift was cancelled and none created.

whole_tenant.description: True when the caller is a supervisor and sees more than their own requests

employee_userid.description: Defaults to the caller. Someone else needs a supervisor.

from_date_str.description: First day off, local, YYYY-MM-DD. Only the first 10 characters are read, so a timestamp counts as its date.

to_date_str.description: Last day off, included. Defaults to from_date_str. Only the first 10 characters are read.

decision_state.description: `applying` while an approval removes shifts, then `applied`

whole_tenant.description: True when the caller is a supervisor and sees more than their own requests
